notes.title: Performance update
notes.content:
-Lowered some of the rendering settings
-added more objects to static
-changed end screen
-minor visual improvements
-added a new ghost detection system instead of the older meter. It uses a blinking light that gets faster as the ghost gets near.

In testing, the game runs significantly faster due to changes
